---
name: User Case
about: Template for documenting use cases with actors, flows, and conditions
title: "[USE CASE] "
labels: use-case
assignees: ''
---

Please complete as many of the fields below as possible.

## Brief Description
<!-- A brief paragraph of text describing the use case. This description should describe the need as well as the desired outcome. -->

## Use Case Actors
<!-- A list users or systems that engage in the activities described in the use case -->

## Pre-conditions
<!-- Anything the solution can assume to be true/must be true when the use case begins. E.g a user must be logged in to the system in order to access the module in question. -->

## Basic Flow
<!-- The set of steps the actors take to accomplish the goal of the use case. A clear description of what the system does in response to each user action -->

## Post-conditions
<!-- The set of success criteria that dictate that the use case is complete -->

## Additional considerations
<!-- Anything else you would like to have under consideration including descriptions of alternate flows or error/exception handling -->

## Requested by
<!-- Who placed the request -->
